nodes.text: Is it true that, for all finite $k<\omega$,\[\omega_1^2\to (\omega_1\omega, 3,\ldots,3)_{k+1}^2?\]

#1171 : [Va99,7.84] set theory | ramsey theory Baumgartner [Ba89b] proved that, assuming a form of Martin's axiom, that $\omega_1\omega\to (\omega_1\omega, 3)^2$.
